main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess 7-bar return on forecast (non-overlapping grid, forecast != 0, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: t >= +2 confirms (with positive supporting difference); t <= -2 rejects; between is inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean excess 7-bar return at forecast > 0 minus at forecast < 0

decided_by: The slope t lies between -2 and +2 (inconclusive rule).
reading: Grid points at positions 0,7,14,... of each window with t+7 inside the window; the coin's mean 7-bar return is the mean over all its grid points in all windows; the minimum counts of the plan's inconclusive rule are applied as minimums (not observable).
